question.knowledge_point: Computing the Limit at Infinity of a Power Function With an Even Power
question.worked_solution:
The graph $y={x}^{12}$ looks similar to an upward parabola, so

$$
{lim}_{x\to \infty }{x}^{12}=\infty .
$$

Multiplication by the positive constant $8$ does not affect the limit at infinity. So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \infty }(8{x}^{12})={lim}_{x\to \infty }({x}^{12})=\infty .\end{aligned}
$$
